The '''2025–26 Danish Superliga''' (officially the '''3F Superliga''' for sponsorship purposes) was the 36th season of the [[Danish Superliga]]. [[F.C. Copenhagen|Copenhagen]] entered the season as the defending champions, having secured the [[2024–25 Danish Superliga|2024–25 title]].

The schedule for the first seven matchdays was released on 6 June 2025, with the opening fixture set for 18 July between [[Viborg FF|Viborg]] and Copenhagen.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web| url=https://superliga.dk/nyheder/kamptidspunkter/2025-2026/kamptidspunkter-for-1-7-spillerunde-er-klar| title=Kamptidspunkter for 1-7. spillerunde er klar| language=da| trans-title=Match times for rounds 1-7 are ready| publisher=Danish Superliga| date=6 June 2025| access-date=19 June 2025}}</ref> Between early December and mid-February, the league entered into its standard winter break during which no league fixtures will be played.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web| url=https://superliga.dk/nyheder/kamptidspunkter/2024-2025/datoplanen-for-saesonen-2025-2026-er-klar| title=Datoplanen for sæsonen 2025-2026 er klar| language=da| trans-title= The date schedule for the 2025-2026 season is ready| publisher=Danish Superliga| date=10 December 2024| access-date=19 June 2025}}</ref>

On 10 May, in the penultimate matchday, [[Aarhus Gymnastikforening|AGF]] defeated [[Brøndby IF|Brøndby]] 2–0 and [[FC Midtjylland|Midtjylland]] drew 0–0 away at [[FC Nordsjælland|Nordsjælland]], which meant that AGF had sealed their first league title in 40 years, having last won the division in [[1986 Danish 1st Division|1986]].<ref>{{cite news |date=10 May 2026 |title=40 års tørke slut: AGF er dansk mester |url=https://bold.dk/fodbold/stillinger/superligaen/nyheder/40-ars-torke-slut-agf-er-dansk-mester |access-date=12 May 2026 |website=Bold.dk |language=Danish}}</ref>

==Teams==
[[Odense Boldklub|OB]] made an immediate return to the [[Danish Superliga|Superliga]] after winning the [[2024–25 Danish 1st Division]] title in a rare appearance at the lower level. [[FC Fredericia|Fredericia]] joined OB in promotion, marking that club's first appearance in the top flight in its existence. Those two teams replaced [[AaB Fodbold|AaB]] and [[Lyngby Boldklub|Lyngby]], which were relegated at the end of the previous season, ending their top flight spells of one and three years respectively.

==European play-offs==
The 4th-placed team of the championship round advanced to a play-off match against the winning team of the qualification round (no. 7) in a single-leg tie, with the team from the championship round as hosts. The winner earned a place in the [[2026–27 UEFA Conference League#Second qualifying round|Conference League second qualifying round]]. Initially intended to be played on 24{{nbsp}}May, due to an agreement with local police as a result of [[Brøndby IF|Brøndby]]'s qualification for the match against [[F.C. Copenhagen|Copenhagen]] (i.e. the [[Copenhagen derby]]), it was moved to 21{{nbsp}}May.<ref>{{cite web |title=Tidspunkt for Europa Playoff kampen |website=3F Superliga |date=15 May 2026 |url=https://superliga.dk/nyheder/tidspunkt-for-europa-playoff-kampen |language=da |access-date=17 May 2026}}</ref>
